verdict.rationale: Canny documents a native integrations directory covering Jira, Linear, GitHub, ClickUp, Asana, Slack, Discord, Intercom, Gong, Fathom, Fireflies and others, described as easy native connections that sync statuses and capture feedback automatically, plus a low-friction MCP connection to ChatGPT/Claude/Cursor with 'no API keys, no engineering.' Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of the actual click-count/setup friction and no evidence of a broader app marketplace beyond the listed integrations.
